spec.prompt_template: Photorealistic e-commerce hero render of a pharmaceutical capsule bottle. CONTAINER: cylindrical 60cc HDPE packer, matte white opaque body 70mm tall x 40mm diameter (diameter:height ~1:1.9), glossy royal-blue ribbed screw cap with tamper-evident ring (~24mm tall). CAMERA: straight-on front, eye-level with slight 5deg high angle, ~85mm equivalent, bottle vertically centered filling ~88% of frame height. LIGHTING: soft large key from top-left, gentle fill, low contrast, no harsh speculars; soft contact shadow plus faint cast to lower-right. BACKGROUND: seamless very-light warm grey #e8e8e7 with subtle floor reflection. LABEL direct-printed on the body, left-aligned on a shared left margin: {badge_clause}the 'Regenic|Lab' wordmark in navy with a cyan vertical divider bar and small cyan leaf accent; after a generous gap, the product name '{product_name}' in Montserrat SemiBold navy #1b2846 (largest element); {dose_clause}below that the form '{form}' in Montserrat Medium muted grey #5b687b with wide letter-spacing. PALETTE: navy #1b2846, cyan #00a1d6, grey #5b687b. TYPOGRAPHY DISCIPLINE (critical): replicate the reference image's text SIZE and SPACING exactly — the product name is modest, about one-eighth of the bottle width tall, NOT large; keep a generous gap (about 1.2x the logo height) between the Regenic|Lab logo and the product name; do NOT enlarge or stretch text to fill the label width — short or single-word names use the SAME modest size as long ones; leave ample empty white space below the form line. If a dose line is shown above, render it EXACTLY as given, preserving commas and UPPERCASE units (e.g. '50,000IU' must appear as '50,000IU', never '50000ui'); if NO dose line is specified above, do NOT invent or add any dose, number or unit anywhere on the label. STYLE: clean, premium, clinical pharmacy, sharp focus, high detail, sRGB. Match the attached reference image for bottle shape, materials, label placement and typography; change ONLY the badge text, product name, dose and form to the values above. Do NOT render 'Novecy' or any third-party/compounder branding. Portrait 874x1326.
spec.cad: CAD source of truth: config/cad/T2_hero.json (regenic Norwood-Ludwig template T2 — capsule-bottle hero). Geometry: cylindrical 60cc HDPE packer, 70mm x 40mm, royal-blue ribbed screw cap. Metafields swap per SKU; this config carries the T2 example SKU (Minoxidil + Biotin).
